narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Use height twelve and parallel sides that add to twelve.
<bookmark mark='half'/>Half of twelve times twelve is seventy two, only half of what we need.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The halving in the formula must be undone somewhere.

narration: <bookmark mark='c1'/>To check, add your two parallel sides and multiply by your height.
<bookmark mark='c2'/>Half of that should give one hundred forty four square centimetres.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor and the trapezium; two check lines appear: add your parallel sides; half of that times the height should be the target
